children: Injective announced that INJ is now integrated into Pump.fun, LaunchOnSF and MeteoraAG, three launch platforms where new tokens can be created and paired with INJ. The integration covers new token issuance, meme launches and tokenized stocks, and participants in these launches earn INJ. This makes INJ a shared pairing asset across the three platforms rather than a listing on a single venue.

The practical effect is a direct demand channel: every launch paired with INJ routes issuance through the asset and pays participants in INJ. Tokenized stocks extend the pairing beyond crypto-native memes to traditional-market references, broadening the range of assets that touch INJ at launch.

The repricing case rests on volume, not the integration itself. Any effect depends on how much future launch activity these platforms attract and how consistently they pair with INJ, so the channel exists but its throughput is unproven.
